ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, what is the producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an ocean food web diagram, labeled with seabirds, dolphins, fish, squid, plankton, and seawater. In the diagram, plankton is located at the lower right, with arrows pointing from the plankton area to consumers such as fish and squid, and then energy flows to larger consumers such as dolphins and seabirds. Reasoning: In a food web, producers are organisms located at the base of the food chain, able to make their own food and provide energy for other organisms. The organism in the diagram that fits this role is plankton, while seawater is not an organism. Therefore, the producer is plankton.
